item.title: Sustainability Research, Policy and Impact: Past, Present and Future
item.content:encoded:
Onyeka Osuji, University of Essex

Colin Moore, University of Essex

David Crowther,

Shahla Seifi,

SRRNet's 25th anniversary conference invites scholars and practitioners to explore the connections between sustainability research, policy, and practical impact. The conference seeks to reflect on lessons learned from corporate social responsibility and sustainability approaches, while also examining how research can better inform current policy and organizational practice, and what future directions the field should pursue.

The conference welcomes interdisciplinary contributions from management science, law, computer science, technology, engineering, philosophy, psychology, and related fields. Both empirical and conceptual papers are encouraged, along with innovative methodologies. Selected papers from the conference will be considered for publication in SRRNet's peer-reviewed journals and book series.
